variants.headline: Looking back: new settlers land from the ship
variants.sub: The ship in port has brought new settlers who landed at {district}.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: New settlers have landed from the ship at {district}.

An arrival adds people to the colony, but it is not a complete labour-market or demand forecast. Commercial readers should avoid assuming particular skills, jobs or purchases from a landing count. Practical judgment requires the distinction between the number arriving and the circumstances of the lives they go on to make.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The responsibility of {target} merits scrutiny through the arrivals and the meaning of settlement. This account records the landing without presuming particular jobs, homes or future outcomes for the people who have arrived.
